slides_slide.title: Onboarding pilot
slides_slide.body:
A quieter first week
Onboarding pilot

Product design · December 2026

Where people pause
Eight starters retraced their first morning with us.

A useful first morning
The first task moves a real project forward.

Make the path visible
The opening page answers three questions in order.

Measure the first task
Target day one for the first useful task.

A reliable review
Each person sees the teammate assigned to review their first task.

Two cohorts, one plan
Begin with a small pilot. Use feedback to revise the path for the second group.

Look for less setup help
Compare setup questions per cohort.

Decision on Friday
If more people finish a real task and fewer need setup help, expand the pilot.
